dict.string: To sync with your other devices on your Wi-Fi, without servers.
To check your goals (for example, counting squats) on this iPhone. No image is ever recorded or sent.
To dictate the summary of what you read. The audio is processed on this iPhone and not saved.
To turn your voice into text on this iPhone, without sending it to any server.
To confirm changes to your rules with Face ID.
To check workout goals with today's exercise minutes. Nothing else is read, nothing is written, and nothing leaves this iPhone.
